pri-001.situation: Thinking of yourself as specially holy.
pri-001.note: Evagrius answers this boast with God’s curse on the serpent, the first proud one.

pri-002.voice: You’re pure now. Impure thoughts don’t touch you anymore.

pri-003.voice: God doesn’t provide for me. I take care of myself.
pri-003.situation: Denying God’s care and the help he sends.

pri-004.voice: Why does studying spiritual things always meet resistance?
pri-004.situation: Wondering why time with God’s word gets crowded out.
pri-004.note: Pharaoh’s strategy was to pile on more work so the people had no time for words of hope. Evagrius sees the same tactic used against those who study God’s word.

pri-005.voice: You don’t need God to save you.
pri-005.situation: Rejecting the salvation by which every other temptation is overcome.

pri-006.voice: I beat my sadness by my own strength.
pri-006.situation: Taking the credit for coming through a dark season.

pri-007.voice: I don’t need any guidance. Nobody can teach me.
pri-007.situation: Scorning the help and correction God sends.

pri-008.voice: Those elders haven’t done any more than I have.
pri-008.situation: Looking down on spiritual elders and mentors.

pri-009.situation: A blasphemous thought pushing your mind toward ruin.
pri-009.note: Unwanted blasphemous thoughts are a common temptation. Having one is not the same as choosing it. Evagrius answers the thought instead of obeying it.

pri-010.voice: Blasphemous thoughts keep coming, and I can’t pray freely.
pri-010.situation: Persistent blasphemous thoughts robbing your prayer of confidence.

pri-011.voice: Knowing Christ and keeping his commands isn’t worth much.
pri-011.situation: Belittling the beauty of knowing Christ.

excerpt.from: The land, which we passed through

pri-012.voice: Is God even in you? Test him and find out.
pri-012.situation: Doubting God’s presence and wanting to put him to the test.

pri-013.voice: I beat these temptations by my own power.
pri-013.situation: Supposing your own strength defeated what was against you.

pri-014.situation: Believing your goodness earned you victory and understanding.

pri-015.voice: Everyone praises you. You’re the father of the wise.

pri-016.voice: You have no free will, so none of it is your fault.
pri-016.situation: Denying free will to escape responsibility for sin.

pri-017.voice: That vision must be from God.
pri-017.situation: Trusting every spiritual experience without discernment.
pri-017.note: Evagrius’s test: a true messenger from God may startle you at first, but leaves joy and deep peace. A false one leaves fear and agitation.

pri-019.voice: These thoughts stop my prayer, so I’ll get on my knees.
pri-019.situation: Answering blasphemous thoughts by kneeling in humble prayer.

pri-020.voice: These frightening blasphemies shake me so much I can’t pray.
pri-020.situation: Shaken by frightening blasphemous thoughts and losing confidence in prayer.

pri-021.voice: Unspeakable words against God keep rising in me.
pri-021.situation: Horrified by blasphemies that seem to speak inside you.
pri-021.note: Evagrius recommends fasting and reading Scripture during this temptation.

pri-022.voice: The victory was mine, not God’s.
pri-022.situation: Denying that victory comes from God.

pri-023.voice: These blasphemous thoughts just won’t leave.
pri-023.situation: Persistent blasphemous thoughts, brought to God.

pri-024.voice: Something proud and dazzling is coming at me.
pri-024.situation: Pride arriving disguised as something bright and good.

pri-025.situation: Crediting a victory to your own ability instead of God’s help.

pri-026.voice: I’ll explain the Scriptures to you myself.
pri-026.situation: Self-appointed spiritual teaching that is really deception.
pri-026.note: Evagrius says Macarius answered such a demon with this verse.

pri-027.voice: Proud thoughts are crowding in from every side.
pri-027.situation: Pride closing in on your mind.

pri-028.voice: My pride makes it hard to pray honestly.
pri-028.situation: Persistent pride stealing your openness in prayer.

pri-029.situation: Blasphemous words rising in your mind.

pri-030.voice: Look how much I’ve built up in other people’s lives.
pri-030.situation: Pride in your spiritual influence on others.

pri-031.situation: Mocking others for neglecting their faith.

pri-032.voice: What feeds the evil that fights me?
pri-032.situation: Wanting to understand what the forces of evil feed on.

pri-033.voice: Why visit them? They don’t know any more than you.
pri-033.situation: Avoiding fellowship because you think you know better.

pri-034.voice: Don’t ask anyone to pray for you. You can handle this.
pri-034.situation: Too proud to ask others for prayer during a long trial.

pri-035.situation: Believing you are clean and without sin.

pri-036.voice: Holy fear? You’ve outgrown it. You’ve succeeded.
pri-036.situation: Treating reverent fear as something only for the unsuccessful.

pri-037.voice: My background makes me better than them.
pri-037.situation: Pride in your family, birth or background.

pri-039.voice: You’ve arrived. You’re a mature believer now.

pri-040.voice: You’re so humble you could stand to be a little proud.
pri-040.situation: Being “cured” of humility by bad advice.

pri-041.voice: Say what you really think about God.
pri-041.situation: Thoughts that try to drag your mind into blasphemy.

pri-042.voice: Let me remind you of what they’ve done wrong.

pri-043.voice: God must be very pleased with my way of life.
pri-043.situation: Pride in your life as an offering to God.

pri-044.situation: A thought that pushes you toward open rebellion against God.

pri-046.situation: Not believing that knowing Christ exposes and terrifies evil.

pri-047.voice: These powers are like gods. Fear them.
pri-047.situation: Giving evil powers a godlike place in your mind.

pri-049a.voice: I had a blasphemous thought, and I’m crushed by it.
pri-049a.situation: Saddened and ashamed after a blasphemous thought.
pri-049a.note: A thought that horrifies you is not one you have chosen. God “does not afflict willingly.”

pri-049b.voice: Blasphemies cloud my mind just when I pray.
pri-049b.situation: Blasphemous thoughts covering your mind at prayer.

pri-050.voice: You should be first among them.
pri-050.situation: Wanting to be first in your community.

pri-051.voice: You’ve done what’s required. That’s plenty.
pri-051.situation: Thinking you’ve done enough for God.

pri-052.voice: I’m in the right. Their weak efforts don’t impress me.
pri-052.situation: Justifying yourself and looking down on other people’s weaker efforts.

pri-053.voice: They only fast because they’re too weak to handle food.
pri-053.situation: Despising someone who practices a discipline you don’t.

pri-054.voice: They eat because they have no self-control.
pri-054.situation: Judging someone who doesn’t keep your discipline.

excerpt.from: Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge

pri-055.voice: I’ve conquered my appetite and my temper.

pri-056.voice: Anything that looks bright and wise must be true.
pri-056.situation: Not believing evil can disguise itself as a teacher of truth.

pri-058.situation: Believing you’ve arrived in obeying God.

pri-059.voice: There’s no sin left in your heart.
pri-059.situation: Pride that says you have no sin.

pri-060.voice: Can I trust myself to stay faithful to the end?
pri-060.situation: Learning to rely on God, not yourself, to keep you to the end.
